text: Kian Romano intercepts the ball near the center of Seabrook Town's half, starting a quick counter. He advances forward and passes to Aiden Quinlan on the right flank near the opponent’s penalty area. Quinlan instantly plays a through ball back to Romano, who is positioned just over 5 metres from Harbour City's goal on the left side. Romano shoots with his foot and scores, putting Seabrook Town ahead 3-2 in the final moments. [#1879] [#1880] [#1881] [#1882]
